questions.question: Which of the following best defines a regular language?

answers.a: A language that can be recognized by a pushdown automaton
answers.b: A language that can be recognized by a finite automaton
answers.c: A language that requires a stack for recognition
answers.d: A language that can only be recognized by a Turing machine

questions.question: Which formalism can be used to describe all regular languages?

answers.b: Finite automata can only remember information through their current state
answers.c: Finite automata can use a stack to store information
answers.d: Finite automata can count arbitrarily large numbers

questions.question: Why can't a finite automaton recognize the language L = { a^n b^n | n ≥ 0 }?

answers.a: Because it needs to count the number of a's and b's
answers.b: Because it has too many states
answers.c: Because the alphabet is too large
answers.d: Because finite automata can only process strings from left to right

answers.b: Every regular language requires a PDA for recognition
answers.c: Regular languages can express nested dependencies
answers.d: Regular languages are a superset of context-free languages
